facts.quote: After going undrafted in the 2023 NFL draft, Saylors signed with the Cincinnati Bengals on April 30, 2023.
On October 18, 2023, Saylors was signed to the Atlanta Falcons' practice squad.
On October 18, 2023, Saylors was signed to the Atlanta Falcons' practice squad. He was waived on January 2, 2024, with an injury settlement.
On June 18, 2024. Saylors signed with the New York Giants.
On August 22, 2024, Saylors signed with the Cleveland Browns, but was waived later that week.
On July 29, 2025, Saylors signed with the Detroit Lions.
On January 5, 2026, the Lions signed Saylors to a one-year contract extension.
On March 16, 2020, Ekeler signed a four-year $24.5 million contract extension with the Chargers.
Ekeler signed a two-year contract with the Washington Commanders on March 18, 2024.
On September 29, 2026, Ekeler re-signed with the Commanders on a one-year deal.
On June 2, 2017, the Bengals signed Mixon to a four-year, $5.45 million contract with $2.81 million guaranteed and a signing bonus of $2.10 million.
On September 1, 2020, Mixon signed a four-year, $48 million contract extension with the Bengals through the 2024 season.

Mixon was traded to the Houston Texans on March 13, 2024, in exchange for a 2024 seventh round selection previously obtained from the Arizona Cardinals, which the Bengals used to select safety Daijahn Anthony.
On March 6, 2026, Mixon was released by the Texans.
On July 27, 2022, Turpin signed a three-year, $2.56 million contract with the Dallas Cowboys of the NFL.
On March 11, 2025, Turpin signed a three-year, $13.5 million contract extension with the Cowboys, with $5 million guaranteed.

On March 16, 2024, Fields was traded to the Pittsburgh Steelers in exchange for a conditional sixth-round pick in the 2025 NFL draft that would have converted to a fourth if he played 51% of the team's snaps, however, he played in less than the said threshold, failing the condition to convert it to a fourth.
On March 13, 2025, Fields signed a two-year, $40 million contract with the New York Jets.
On March 18, 2026, the Jets traded Fields to the Kansas City Chiefs in exchange for a sixth-round pick in the 2027 NFL draft.
On March 19, 2020, the Broncos released Flacco with a failed physical designation.
On May 27, 2020, Flacco signed a one-year, $1.5 million deal with the New York Jets as the backup quarterback to 2018 first-round pick Sam Darnold.
On March 25, 2021, Flacco signed a one-year, $3.5 million contract with the Philadelphia Eagles to back up 2020 second-round pick Jalen Hurts.
On October 25, 2021, the Eagles traded Flacco back to the Jets for a conditional sixth-round draft pick, after Jets starting quarterback Zach Wilson suffered a knee injury.
On March 16, 2022, Flacco re-signed with the Jets on a one-year, $3.5 million deal.

After not finding his way onto a team roster through the beginning of the 2023 season, Flacco was signed to the Cleveland Browns practice squad on November 20, 2023, following a season-ending injury to starting quarterback Deshaun Watson.
On March 22, 2024, Flacco signed with the Indianapolis Colts on a one-year deal.
On October 7, 2025, Flacco, along with a sixth-round pick, was traded to the Cincinnati Bengals in exchange for a fifth-round pick.
On March 24, 2026, Flacco re-signed with the Bengals on a one-year, $6 million contract.

Davis made 16 appearances for the Jets during the 2025 campaign, recording 43 attempts for 236 yards and one touchdown; he also tallied 21 receptions for 186 yards. On January 3, 2026, Davis was placed on season-ending injured reserve due to a concussion.
On May 8, 2025, Fitzgerald signed with the Carolina Panthers as an undrafted free agent after going unselected in the 2025 NFL draft.
On March 17, 2017, Folk was signed as a free agent by the Tampa Bay Buccaneers, to compete with the previous year's second-round draft choice Roberto Aguayo.
On February 22, 2018, Folk was released from the Buccaneers.
On October 29, 2019, following the release of Mike Nugent, Folk was signed by the New England Patriots.
On December 6, 2019, Folk was re-signed by the Patriots.
The Patriots re-signed Folk on August 24, 2020.
On March 23, 2021, Folk re-signed with the Patriots.
Folk re-signed with the Patriots on March 15, 2022, to a two-year, $5 million deal.
On August 29, 2023, Folk was traded from the Patriots to the Tennessee Titans in exchange for a 2025 seventh-round draft pick.
On March 20, 2024, Folk re-signed with the Titans.
On July 29, 2025, Folk signed a one-year contract to return to the New York Jets.
On March 12, 2026, Folk signed a two-year contract with the Atlanta Falcons.
Estimé was drafted in the fifth round with the 147th overall pick by the Denver Broncos in the 2024 NFL draft. He was placed on injured reserve on September 11, 2024.
On August 25, 2025, he was waived by the Broncos.
On August 29, 2025, Estimé signed with the Philadelphia Eagles practice squad.
On October 21, 2025, Estimé was signed to the New Orleans Saints' practice squad.
On September 22, 2026, Estimé was waived by the Saints with an injury settlement.
On September 30, 2026, Estimé signed to the Minnesota Vikings practice squad.

On August 22, 2024, the Commanders traded Dotson and a fifth-round pick to the Philadelphia Eagles in exchange for a conditional third-round pick (higher of Eagles or Dolphins) and two seventh-round picks in the 2025 NFL draft.
On March 12, 2026, Dotson signed a two-year, $15 million contract with the Atlanta Falcons.
On May 10, 2024, the Carolina Panthers signed Legette to a fully guaranteed four-year, $12.35 million contract that includes a signing bonus of $5.80 million.
On October 1, 2020, Johnson was waived by the Lions.
On October 2, 2020, Johnson was claimed off waivers by the New York Jets.
On August 21, 2023, Johnson signed with the Buffalo Bills.
Johnson re-signed with the Bills on March 19, 2024.
On March 11, 2025, Johnson re-signed with Buffalo on a two-year, $5 million contract.
